report_identity.report_title: Shanghai Gench Education Group Limited Annual Report 2023

business_overview.one_sentence: The group provides private higher vocational education in Mainland China through Shanghai Jian Qiao University, with revenue mainly from tuition and boarding fees paid in advance.

segments.name: Higher education services
segments.facts: The group operated in one geographical location and all revenue was generated in the PRC; no separate operating segment information was presented.

business_overview.revenue_model: Tuition fees and boarding fees are generally paid in advance before the academic year and recognised over time as services are rendered.
business_notes: Full-time enrolled students reached 25,013 in the 2023/24 school year.
Revenue comprised tuition fees RMB781.456m, boarding fees RMB125.996m, education related services RMB17.950m and other services RMB4.483m.
Certain education subsidiaries are controlled through contractual arrangements because foreign investors are prohibited from investing directly in the restricted education business.

non_recurring_items.business_substance: Government grants included in other income.
non_recurring_items.source: Annual report 2023 note 5, other income and gains

non_recurring_items.item: Fair value and other interest income from FVTPL wealth management products

non_recurring_items.source: Annual report 2023 note 5 and cash flow adjustments

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Current portion of secured long-term bank loans.
Secured bank loans, all denominated in RMB; RMB724.403m secured by tuition and boarding fee rights and RMB35.023m by talent center income rights.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Advance tuition and boarding fees for unsatisfied performance obligations; students are entitled to refund of unrendered services.
Student advances for textbooks, military training, medical examination and insurance to be paid on students' behalf.

Annual report 2023 income statement and cash flow statement

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported operating cash flow exceeded profit in 2022 and 2023, helped by advance tuition and boarding fee receipts. However, the school business requires ongoing campus maintenance/upgrade capex and the 2023 capex was high because of phase four construction, so distributable cash profit is discounted materially.

evidence.source: Annual report 2023 consolidated statement of profit or loss, RMB'000
Annual report 2023 consolidated statement of cash flows, RMB'000
Annual report 2023 cash flow statement: PPE purchases, ROU additions and intangible additions, RMB'000

gaps: The annual report does not split cash between listed parent, offshore subsidiaries, PRC operating subsidiaries and contractual-arrangement entities.
No restricted cash line was disclosed in the 2023 balance sheet, but tuition/boarding fee rights secured most bank borrowings and contract liabilities create operating obligations.
Only 2022 and 2023 operating cash flow and capex were extracted from this annual report; 2021 cash flow was not re-extracted from the 2021 annual report in this run.
